title: Reinterpreting non-local memories is a cognitive glue that makes Selves

fields.label: Label
fields.value: Reinterpreting non-local memories is a cognitive glue that makes Selves

fields.label: Statement
fields.value: Levin proposes that mnemonic improvisation, the ability to modify, remap and interpret non-local memories onto new media and contexts, is one of the kinds of cognitive glue that binds parts into a Self at every scale.

fields.label: Work
fields.value: Self-Improvising Memory: A Perspective on Memories as Agential, Dynamically Reinterpreting Cognitive Glue

fields.label: Chapter
fields.value: Levin M 2024, Self-Improvising Memory: A Perspective on Memories as Agential, Dynamically Reinterpreting Cognitive Glue › 1. Introduction and Overview

fields.label: Quotation
fields.value: Thus, I propose that the ability to modify and interpret non-local memories is one of the kinds of cognitive glue that reifies Selves (at all scales) [23,24,25].

fields.label: Assumptions
fields.value: Levin M, “Self-Improvising Memory: A Perspective on Memories as Agential, Dynamically Reinterpreting Cognitive Glue”, Entropy (Basel, Switzerland) (2024), doi:10.3390/e26060481; section “1. Introduction and Overview”. Scope: Agents at all scales, from cells to organisms

fields.label: Assessment
fields.value: GPT-5.6 Sol on levin-2024-memory-04: not-empirically-resolvable, resolvability 0.13

fields.label: Finding
fields.value: One could measure integration after memory manipulations in a chosen model, but that would test an added operationalization rather than the claim as stated. No observation uniquely distinguishes reification of a Self from ordinary system coupling.

fields.label: Proposed test in the assessment
fields.value: Proposed test with existing data: A test would need an independent quantitative measure of Selfhood and a manipulation of non-local memory interpretation, neither of which is defined across the claimed scales.

fields.label: Evidence against
fields.value:
Cognitive glue and Selfhood are not independently measured.

The all-scales scope prevents a common decision rule.

fields.label: Dimension scores
fields.value:
analysis feasibility: 0.2
data adequacy: 0.05
operationalizability: 0.15
discriminating power: 0.1
data existence: 0.15

fields.label: Finding
fields.value: Mnemonic improvisation is offered as one kind of cognitive glue that reifies Selves. Coupling, shared dynamics, and information flow are non-cognitive descriptions of the same multi-scale organization, and no public observation picks the glue account out from those rivals. The proposal stays conceptual.

fields.label: Proposed test in the assessment
fields.value: Proposed test with existing data: Remapping of stored information onto a new context can be measured in particular systems, but success or failure of remapping would not show that this capacity is what binds parts into a Self.

fields.label: Evidence against
fields.value:
The claim quantifies over every scale, from cells to organisms.

Self is not given an operational boundary distinct from physiological or informational coupling.
